name: Bea the Cleaner
bio: The Nocturna have a lot of enemies outside the Evernight Basin. Travel is risky – better for a human to do the dirty work. Bea is that human. Consummate professional and master assassin, the Cleaner always gets the job done – no mess, no witnesses.
